Container.Name: wickline
Container.Overview: Wickline Self-Hosted (unofficial): the open-source Wickline charting platform running 24/7 on your server. Your watchlists, layouts, drawings, custom indicators and alerts sync across devices, and price alerts keep running (with Gotify notifications) when no browser is open. Single-user login. Intended for LAN/Tailscale; optional public mode with HTTPS and two-factor login. Generate the password hash in the container console: node selfhost/cli.mjs hash-password
Container.Requires: Generate WICKLINE_PASSWORD_HASH first: docker run --rm -it ghcr.io/mtrifan/wickline:edge node selfhost/cli.mjs hash-password

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database, backups. Must be writable by UID 99 (nobody:users, the Unraid default).

Config.Name: Password hash
Config.Description: Output of: node selfhost/cli.mjs hash-password (starts with scrypt$).

Config.Name: Two-factor secret (TOTP)
Config.Description: Optional on LAN/Tailscale, required for public mode. Output of: node selfhost/cli.mjs totp-setup

Config.Name: Exposure
Config.Description: private: LAN/Tailscale. public: reachable from the internet through an HTTPS reverse proxy (requires TOTP and Trust proxy).

Config.Name: Trust proxy
Config.Description: Number of reverse proxies in front (Tailscale Serve, NPM, Caddy, Cloudflare Tunnel). false when accessed directly.

Config.Name: Trusted proxy addresses
Config.Description: IPs/CIDRs of your reverse proxy (comma-separated). Empty = loopback and private networks. Set it explicitly in public mode.

Config.Name: Outbound proxy
Config.Description: HTTP or SOCKS5 proxy for market data, if Yahoo/Binance are blocked.
